Running command: python3 -c "
import tarfile
tar = tarfile.open('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/stb/jpg.tar.gz')
for member in tar:
    if member.name.endswith('.jpg'):
        f = tar.extractfile(member)
        data = f.read()
        # Find all markers
        i = 0
        while i < len(data) - 1:
            if data[i] == 0xff:
                marker = data[i+1]
                if marker == 0xd8:
                    print(f'SOI at {i}')
                    i += 2
                elif marker == 0xd9:
                    print(f'EOI at {i}')
                    break
                elif marker in (0xc0, 0xc1, 0xc2):
                    length = (data[i+2] << 8) | data[i+3]
                    print(f'SOF{marker-0xc0} at {i}, length={length}')
                    print(f'  Precision: {data[i+4]}, Height: {(data[i+5]<<8)|data[i+6]}, Width: {(data[i+7]<<8)|data[i+8]}')
                    ncomp = data[i+9]
                    print(f'  Components: {ncomp}')
                    offset = i + 10
                    for c in range(ncomp):
                        comp_id = data[offset]
                        sampling = data[offset+1]
                        h = sampling >> 4
                        v = sampling & 0x0f
                        tq = data[offset+2]
                        print(f'    Comp {c}: id={comp_id}, h={h}, v={v}, tq={tq}')
                        offset += 3
                    i += length + 2
                elif marker == 0xda:
                    length = (data[i+2] << 8) | data[i+3]
                    print(f'SOS at {i}, length={length}')
                    i += length + 2
                elif marker == 0xdb:
                    length = (data[i+2] << 8) | data[i+3]
                    print(f'DQT at {i}, length={length}')
                    i += length + 2
                elif marker == 0xc4:
                    length = (data[i+2] << 8) | data[i+3]
                    print(f'DHT at {i}, length={length}')
                    i += length + 2
                elif marker == 0xe0:
                    length = (data[i+2] << 8) | data[i+3]
                    print(f'APP0 at {i}, length={length}')
                    i += length + 2
                elif marker == 0xfe:
                    length = (data[i+2] << 8) | data[i+3]
                    print(f'COM at {i}, length={length}')
                    i += length + 2
                elif marker == 0xdd:
                    length = (data[i+2] << 8) | data[i+3]
                    print(f'DRI at {i}, length={length}')
                    i += length + 2
                elif marker == 0x00:
                    i += 1
                else:
                    print(f'Unknown marker {marker:02x} at {i}')
                    # Skip to next marker
                    i += 1
            else:
                i += 1
        break
"
